findings.description: VspColorSemantic hardcodes VspColorLight.* values for all state colors. Dark mode GPS/sync/data-confidence colors are incorrect — all semantic colors resolve to light palette even when isDark=true. Examples: gpsReady, gpsLowAccuracy, online, offline, syncPending, syncFailed, official, estimated, stale all use VspColorLight palette constants.
findings.recommendation: VspColorSemantic should resolve colors based on current brightness. Recommended fix: in components that already have BuildContext (VspCard, VspDistanceDisplay), use Theme.of(context).colorScheme.tertiary/secondary/error values directly for semantic state colors instead of VspColorSemantic static constants. Alternatively, add brightness parameter to VspColorSemantic.

findings.description: VspButton._FocusRingWrapper hardcodes colorScheme.primary instead of VspFocusRing.color token. VspFocusRing.color is defined in vsp_focus.dart but _FocusRingWrapper at line 299 ignores it.
findings.recommendation: Replace hardcoded Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary with VspFocusRing.color in _FocusRingWrapper.build() at line 299.

findings.description: VspScaleRatio.large (2.0) is defined but _scaled() only applies VspScaleRatio.medium (1.5) when boldText=true. Per Flutter's MediaQuery.boldTextOf, this is binary — the large ratio is never consumed.
findings.recommendation: Document that Flutter bold text maps to medium scale ratio, or remove the unused large ratio from the token definition.

findings.description: CSS dark mode --vsp-color-ring is #FDBA74 but color.yaml dark.ring is #FB923C. CSS value is orange-300 while token spec defines orange-400 (#FB923C) for dark mode focus ring. Orange-300 may not meet 4.5:1 contrast against #0F172A.
findings.recommendation: Change --vsp-color-ring in [data-theme="dark"] from #FDBA74 to #FB923C to match color.yaml dark.ring value.
